## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle parallel translation of the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī-sūtra* by the Táng Indian translator **Divākara** ([地婆訶羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%B0%E5%A9%86%E8%A8%B6%E7%BE%85), 614–688) — companion to Buddhapāli's [KR6j0144](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0144) (T967), Dù Xíngyǐ's [KR6j0145](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0145) (T968), and Divākara's own second translation [KR6j0147](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0147) (T970). The title varies slightly: *Zuìshèng* 最勝 ("Most-Victorious") rather than *Zūnshèng* 尊勝 ("Honoured-Victorious") — the two are functionally synonymous Chinese renderings of Sanskrit *vijaya*.

**Abstract**

Divākara's two parallel translations (T969 = [KR6j0146](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0146) and T970 = [KR6j0147](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0147)) document his sustained attention to the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī-sūtra* tradition. The translation dates from his documented Cháng'ān period (676–688).
